verdict.rationale: Bitbucket documents AI-triggered pipeline automations (bitbucket-docs-4) that run tasks like cleanup, doc updates, release notes, and flaky test fixes from the pipeline, and Rovo AI code review runs automatically on changes (bitbucket-docs-3/19). However these are scoped to CI/CD triggers rather than a general-purpose autonomous background agent framework. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of these automations running unattended end-to-end, details on scheduling/triggering flexibility, and confirmation of true autonomy beyond pipeline-triggered tasks.
